caption:
Soft arches.

A beauty salon in cream and taupe: arched mirrors lit along their edge, a manicure corner with polish displayed in an arched niche, pedicure and shampoo side by side under a wave of backlit shelving, and a reception with a stone counter and a curved sofa.

Interior design & 3D visualization by KAÏRA Interior Design.
